title: There Will Never Be Another You
notes: ABAC, 32 bars. The bars to check: 11-12, written here as | Dbm7 | Gb7 |, which some charts write as | Db7 | Db7 | or | Abm7 Db7 |; bar 16 is F7 here, often played as Bb7 leading back to Eb. In the last section bar 26 | Abm7 Db7 | is sometimes just | Abm7 |.
